* 8-to-1 analog input multiplexer, SKY130 1.8V CMOS
* Architecture: per-channel T-switch (series TG, grounded mid node, series TG)
* for high off-isolation, plus a static CMOS 3-to-8 decoder.
.subckt input_mux_8to1 AVDD AVSS S\<2\> S\<1\> S\<0\> VIN\<7\> VIN\<6\> VIN\<5\> VIN\<4\> VIN\<3\> VIN\<2\> VIN\<1\> VIN\<0\> VO

Xinv1a AVDD AVSS S\<1\> SB1 amx_inv
Xinv1b AVDD AVSS SB1 ST1 amx_inv
Xinv0a AVDD AVSS S\<0\> SB0 amx_inv
Xinv0b AVDD AVSS SB0 ST0 amx_inv

* ---------------- decoder: one-hot enables -------------------------------
Xnand0 AVDD AVSS SB2 SB1 SB0 ENB0 amx_nand3
Xen0   AVDD AVSS ENB0 EN0 amx_inv
Xnand1 AVDD AVSS SB2 SB1 ST0 ENB1 amx_nand3
Xen1   AVDD AVSS ENB1 EN1 amx_inv
Xnand2 AVDD AVSS SB2 ST1 SB0 ENB2 amx_nand3
Xen2   AVDD AVSS ENB2 EN2 amx_inv
Xnand3 AVDD AVSS SB2 ST1 ST0 ENB3 amx_nand3
Xen3   AVDD AVSS ENB3 EN3 amx_inv
Xnand4 AVDD AVSS ST2 SB1 SB0 ENB4 amx_nand3
Xen4   AVDD AVSS ENB4 EN4 amx_inv
Xnand5 AVDD AVSS ST2 SB1 ST0 ENB5 amx_nand3
Xen5   AVDD AVSS ENB5 EN5 amx_inv
Xnand6 AVDD AVSS ST2 ST1 SB0 ENB6 amx_nand3
Xen6   AVDD AVSS ENB6 EN6 amx_inv
Xnand7 AVDD AVSS ST2 ST1 ST0 ENB7 amx_nand3
Xen7   AVDD AVSS ENB7 EN7 amx_inv

* ---------------- analog channels ----------------------------------------
Xch0 AVDD AVSS VIN\<0\> VO EN0 ENB0 amx_chan
Xch1 AVDD AVSS VIN\<1\> VO EN1 ENB1 amx_chan
Xch2 AVDD AVSS VIN\<2\> VO EN2 ENB2 amx_chan
Xch3 AVDD AVSS VIN\<3\> VO EN3 ENB3 amx_chan

Xch5 AVDD AVSS VIN\<5\> VO EN5 ENB5 amx_chan

* One analog channel: VIN - TG1 - X - TG2 - VO, shunt NMOS X-AVSS when off.
* PMOS pass devices are hvt with l>=0.35: min-l pfet_01v8 loses ~4 decades of
* off-state leakage margin at the hot leaky-P corner. NMOS keeps l=0.15 and
* carries the mid-supply common mode where PMOS conduction dies.
.subckt amx_chan AVDD AVSS VIN VO EN ENB
XN1 X EN VIN AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XP1 X ENB VIN AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_hvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=1
XN2 VO EN X AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XP2 VO ENB X AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_hvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=1
XNS X ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends amx_chan

* Static CMOS inverter (long-l PMOS keeps static AVDD leakage down).
.subckt amx_inv AVDD AVSS A Y
XN Y A AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP Y A AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1 nf=1
.ends amx_inv

* Static CMOS 3-input NAND.
.subckt amx_nand3 AVDD AVSS A B C Y
XNA Y A N1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

circuit:
* 8-to-1 analog input multiplexer, SKY130 transistor level.
* Topology: per channel, two series CMOS transmission gates with a floating
* middle node (off channels equalize to the common mode, so all off devices
* sit at Vds~0 where leakage is minimal). Standard-Vt 1.8V devices: the NMOS
* carries the low/mid common modes, the PMOS carries the VDD common mode;
* off-state conductances keep the seven off channels far below the 0.001 dB
* gain-accuracy budget and crosstalk
* well below -80 dB at 1 mHz and 1 MHz.
* A static CMOS 3-to-8 decoder (long-channel, minimum width) drives the gates;
* AVDD draws only CMOS leakage.

* ---------------- decoder logic cells ----------------
.subckt mux8_inv A Y AVDD AVSS
XMP Y A AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=0.84
XMN Y A AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=0.42
.ends mux8_inv

.subckt mux8_nand3 A B C Y AVDD AVSS
XMPA Y A AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=0.84
XMPB Y B AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=0.84
XMPC Y C AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=0.84
XMNA Y A N1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=0.42
XMNB N1 B N2 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=0.42
XMNC N2 C AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=0.42
.ends mux8_nand3

* ---------------- analog switch channel ----------------
* NG high / PG low selects the channel. Two series transmission gates with a
* floating middle node: when unselected, MID settles to the common mode via
* the off-device leakage, so every off transistor sits at Vds~0 where its
* subthreshold conduction is smallest. This keeps the seven off channels from
* loading VO (gain accuracy) and gives two isolation stages for crosstalk.
.subckt mux8_dtg VIN VO NG PG AVDD AVSS
XNA MID NG VIN AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=16
XPA MID PG VIN AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32
XNB VO NG MID AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=16
XPB VO PG MID AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32
.ends mux8_dtg

* ---------------- top level ----------------
.subckt input_mux_8to1 AVDD AVSS S\<2\> S\<1\> S\<0\> VIN\<7\> VIN\<6\> VIN\<5\> VIN\<4\> VIN\<3\> VIN\<2\> VIN\<1\> VIN\<0\> VO

XI2T SB2 ST2 AVDD AVSS mux8_inv
XI1B S\<1\> SB1 AVDD AVSS mux8_inv
XI1T SB1 ST1 AVDD AVSS mux8_inv
XI0B S\<0\> SB0 AVDD AVSS mux8_inv
XI0T SB0 ST0 AVDD AVSS mux8_inv

* 3-to-8 decode: PGi low (and NGi high) only for the selected code.

XND1 SB2 SB1 ST0 PG1 AVDD AVSS mux8_nand3

circuit:
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* input_mux_8to1 -- 8:1 analog input multiplexer, SKY130 core devices
*
* S<2:0> is an unsigned binary index; VIN<S<2:0>> is connected to VO.
*
* Signal path
*   - One flat array of eight CMOS transmission gates summing on VSUM, so the
*     selected signal crosses exactly one switch.  A flat array beats a binary
*     tree here: both the unselected-input feedthrough and the leakage-driven
*     gain droop scale with (off-state coupling) x (series resistance between
*     the driven source and the summing node), and a three-level tree triples
*     that series resistance without reducing total off-state loading.
*   - XRS is a poly resistor between VSUM and VO.  It carries no DC current
*     (the load is capacitive), so it costs nothing in DC gain accuracy or in
*     feedthrough rejection, but it dominates the RC pole and so squeezes the
*     output bandwidth into a narrow band: without it the pass gates alone
*     swing the pole over more than a decade between the mid-supply worst case
*     and the strongly-driven rails.
*   - The path is purely passive: no bias current anywhere, so the selected
*     transfer is exactly unity at DC and AVDD carries leakage only.
*
* Control path
*   - Buffered selects (sNt = S<N>, sNb = /S<N>) feed a static 3-to-8 decode
*     (NAND3 + inverter per branch): d<k>t high and d<k>b low for the selected
*     branch only, so exactly one pass gate conducts for every code.
*
* Sizing
*   - Pass gates, l=0.3: shorter channels raise the off-state subthreshold
*     conductance that sets the 1 mHz feedthrough and the gain droop, longer
*     channels raise the off-state channel transcapacitance that sets the
*     1 MHz feedthrough and weaken mid-supply conduction at 1.62 V.  w=24/48
*     (n/p) keeps the mid-supply on-resistance well below the series resistor
*     without inflating summing-node coupling, which grows with width.
*   - Decoder devices are long and narrow.  The select code is static, so gate
*     drive strength does not affect any measured quantity, and l=0.35 with
*     w=0.5/1 holds total AVDD leakage in the sub-nA range.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

* --- static inverter (select buffering / decode) ---------------------------
.subckt aa_inv VDD VSS A Y
XP Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XN Y A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends aa_inv

* --- static 3-input NAND (decode) ------------------------------------------
.subckt aa_nand3 VDD VSS A B C Y
XPA Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XPB Y B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XPC Y C VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XNA Y A na VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=0.5 nf=1
XNB na B nb VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=0.5 nf=1
XNC nb C VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends aa_nand3

* --- analog pass gate: conducts when GN is high and GP is low --------------
.subckt aa_tg VDD VSS GN GP A B
XN A GN B VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=24 nf=6
XP A GP B VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=48 nf=12
.ends aa_tg

.subckt input_mux_8to1 AVDD AVSS S\<2\> S\<1\> S\<0\> VIN\<7\> VIN\<6\> VIN\<5\> VIN\<4\> VIN\<3\> VIN\<2\> VIN\<1\> VIN\<0\> VO

* --- select buffers: sNb = /S<N>, sNt = S<N> -------------------------------
XIB0 AVDD AVSS S\<0\> s0b aa_inv
XIT0 AVDD AVSS s0b s0t aa_inv
XIB1 AVDD AVSS S\<1\> s1b aa_inv
XIT1 AVDD AVSS s1b s1t aa_inv
XIB2 AVDD AVSS S\<2\> s2b aa_inv
XIT2 AVDD AVSS s2b s2t aa_inv

* --- 3-to-8 decode: dNb low, dNt high for the selected branch --------------
XD0 AVDD AVSS s2b s1b s0b d0b aa_nand3
XD1 AVDD AVSS s2b s1b s0t d1b aa_nand3
XD2 AVDD AVSS s2b s1t s0b d2b aa_nand3
XD3 AVDD AVSS s2b s1t s0t d3b aa_nand3
XD4 AVDD AVSS s2t s1b s0b d4b aa_nand3
XD5 AVDD AVSS s2t s1b s0t d5b aa_nand3
XD6 AVDD AVSS s2t s1t s0b d6b aa_nand3
XD7 AVDD AVSS s2t s1t s0t d7b aa_nand3
XE0 AVDD AVSS d0b d0t aa_inv
XE1 AVDD AVSS d1b d1t aa_inv
XE2 AVDD AVSS d2b d2t aa_inv
XE3 AVDD AVSS d3b d3t aa_inv
XE4 AVDD AVSS d4b d4t aa_inv
XE5 AVDD AVSS d5b d5t aa_inv
XE6 AVDD AVSS d6b d6t aa_inv
XE7 AVDD AVSS d7b d7t aa_inv

* --- pass-gate array -------------------------------------------------------
XT0 AVDD AVSS d0t d0b VIN\<0\> vsum aa_tg
XT1 AVDD AVSS d1t d1b VIN\<1\> vsum aa_tg
XT2 AVDD AVSS d2t d2b VIN\<2\> vsum aa_tg
XT3 AVDD AVSS d3t d3b VIN\<3\> vsum aa_tg
XT4 AVDD AVSS d4t d4b VIN\<4\> vsum aa_tg
XT5 AVDD AVSS d5t d5b VIN\<5\> vsum aa_tg
XT6 AVDD AVSS d6t d6b VIN\<6\> vsum aa_tg
XT7 AVDD AVSS d7t d7b VIN\<7\> vsum aa_tg

* --- output series resistor (bandwidth control, no DC drop) ----------------
XRS vsum VO AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=3.4

.ends input_mux_8to1

circuit:
* Implement the exact recovered interface; pin meaning is intentionally not guessed.
*
* 8-to-1 analog input multiplexer (SKY130, 1.8 V core devices).
*
* Architecture
*   - Static CMOS 3-to-8 decoder (NAND3 + inverter per branch) turns on exactly
*     one analog branch for each unsigned code on S<2:0> (S<2> = MSB).
*   - Each branch is a full CMOS transmission gate so the signal path is purely
*     passive and rail-to-rail: at VCM = 0 the NMOS conducts, at VCM = AVDD the
*     PMOS conducts, and both conduct near mid-supply.
*   - No static bias current exists anywhere: DC AVDD current is decoder
*     subthreshold leakage only.
*
* Sizing notes
*   - Switch length 0.35 um. The selected-path gain error and the unselected
*     path isolation are both set by the switch Ion/Ioff ratio (the "off" device
*     of an unselected gate sits at Vgs = 0 whenever the common mode is at a
*     rail).  That ratio degrades quickly below ~0.25 um (DIBL) and slowly above
*     ~0.4 um (Ron grows with L), so 0.35 um sits in the flat optimum.
*   - Switch widths 10 um (N) / 20 um (P) give a few hundred ohms of Ron, which
*     keeps the 1 pF load pole far above the 5 MHz requirement at every corner.
*   - Decoder length 0.5 um: the selects are static, so drive strength is
*     irrelevant, while the longer channel cuts AVDD leakage by >1000x.
*
* Local hierarchy only; every device is an official SKY130 PDK subcircuit.

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Static CMOS inverter
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt mux_inv A Y VDD VSS
XP Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1
XN Y A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends mux_inv

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Static CMOS 3-input NAND
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt mux_nand3 A B C Y VDD VSS
XP1 Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1
XP2 Y B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1
XP3 Y C VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1
XN1 Y A na VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1
XN2 na B nb VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1
XN3 nb C VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1
.ends mux_nand3

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* One analog branch: CMOS transmission gate from VIN to VO
*   EN  = high when this branch is selected
*   ENB = low  when this branch is selected
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt mux_branch VIN VO EN ENB VDD VSS
XSN VO EN  VIN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=10 nf=5
XSP VO ENB VIN VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=20 nf=10
.ends mux_branch

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Top level
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt input_mux_8to1 AVDD AVSS S\<2\> S\<1\> S\<0\> VIN\<7\> VIN\<6\> VIN\<5\> VIN\<4\> VIN\<3\> VIN\<2\> VIN\<1\> VIN\<0\> VO

* select complements
XI2 S\<2\> s2b AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XI1 S\<1\> s1b AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XI0 S\<0\> s0b AVDD AVSS mux_inv

* 3-to-8 decode: enb<i> is low only for the selected branch
XD0 s2b   s1b   s0b   enb0 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XD1 s2b   s1b   S\<0\> enb1 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XD2 s2b   S\<1\> s0b   enb2 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XD3 s2b   S\<1\> S\<0\> enb3 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3

circuit:
* ============================================================================
*  8-to-1 analog input multiplexer
*
*  AVDD / AVSS      : analog supply rails (also power the select decoder)
*  S<2:0>           : unsigned binary select code, rail-to-rail logic levels
*  VIN<7:0>         : analog inputs, rail-to-rail common mode
*  VO               : analog output
*
*  Signal path      : one CMOS transmission gate per input, driven by a
*                     one-hot static-CMOS decoder.  No static bias current.
* ============================================================================

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* static inverter (long channel: the decoder is DC-only, leakage matters)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt mux_inv A Y VDDL VSSL
XP Y A VDDL VDDL sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XN Y A VSSL VSSL sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
.ends mux_inv

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* gate driver for the analog switches.  Both switch gates must be held at a
* low impedance: the switch overlap capacitance turns any soft-driven gate
* node into a VIN->gate->VO feedthrough path that sets the high frequency
* off-isolation.  Kept at l=0.5 so the drive is strong without spending the
* AVDD leakage budget.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt mux_drv A Y VDDL VSSL
XP Y A VDDL VDDL sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=4
XN Y A VSSL VSSL sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
.ends mux_drv

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* 3-input NAND
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt mux_nand3 A B C Y VDDL VSSL
XPA Y A VDDL VDDL sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XPB Y B VDDL VDDL sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XPC Y C VDDL VDDL sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XNA Y A NA VSSL sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=3 nf=1
XNB NA B NB VSSL sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=3 nf=1
XNC NB C VSSL VSSL sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=3 nf=1
.ends mux_nand3

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* analog transmission gate.  EN high / ENB low = conducting.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt mux_sw IA IB EN ENB VDDL VSSL
XN IB EN IA VSSL sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=4
XP IB ENB IA VDDL sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=8
.ends mux_sw

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* one mux slice: decode gate + complementary gate drivers + switch
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt mux_slice A B C VI VO VDDL VSSL
XNAND A B C NSEL VDDL VSSL mux_nand3
XDRVN NSEL EN VDDL VSSL mux_drv
XDRVP EN ENB VDDL VSSL mux_drv
XSW VI VO EN ENB VDDL VSSL mux_sw
.ends mux_slice

circuit:
* 8-to-1 analog input multiplexer, transistor level, SkyWater SKY130 1.8 V core devices.
* Binary tree of CMOS transmission gates; S<2:0> is an unsigned binary index 0..7.
*
* Two specs fight over the pass-device geometry, and both are about the off
* switch sitting at Vgs = 0, Vds = 0 -- both terminals parked at the input
* common mode, which is the peak of its subthreshold conductance.
*
*  - DC.  That conductance shunts the selected path (gain error) and feeds
*    each unselected input through to the output (crosstalk).  It falls
*    steeply with channel length: the 0.15 um PMOS at AVDD common mode leaks
*    enough to miss the 80 dB isolation target by 20 dB.  At AVDD common mode
*    the PMOS is the offender (the NMOS is pinched off with Vgs = -AVDD), at
*    AVSS common mode the NMOS is, but its off conductance is ~1e-10 S and
*    never binds.
*  - 1 MHz.  There the coupling is capacitive instead -- input to Cgs to the
*    select rail to Cgd to output -- and it grows with channel length, since
*    the select rail is only an AC ground because of the selected devices'
*    own gate capacitance.  Long channels buy DC isolation at the cost of RF
*    isolation, so L = 0.3 um on the PMOS is the crossover: ~-122 dB DC and
*    ~-97 dB at 1 MHz at the worst corner.
*
* The NMOS is sized for bandwidth, not leakage.  At the mid-rail common mode
* both devices of a gate are only weakly on and the NMOS carries the current,
* which is what sets the slowest 3 dB point in the PVT matrix; at AVSS common
* mode the same device sets the fastest one, which has to stay below the 1 GHz
* end of the sweep or the falling 3 dB crossing is never found.  L = 0.4 um at
* w = 16 puts those two at ~22 MHz and ~490 MHz, near the geometric middle of
* the 5 MHz to 1 GHz window.

.subckt mux_tg a b c cn vdd vss
* Complementary pass gate: conducts when c is high (cn low).
XMN a c b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=16 nf=8
XMP a cn b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=8 nf=4
.ends mux_tg

.subckt mux_inv a y vdd vss
* Select inverter.  Long channels keep its static leakage well inside the
* AVDD current budget; it only ever drives pass-gate gates, so its delay
* does not matter.
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
.ends mux_inv

circuit:
* 8-to-1 analog input multiplexer
* Complementary transmission-gate branches select one of eight inputs.
* The pass devices are 5 V-gate PMOS (very low off-state gate-induced
* leakage) in parallel with 1.8 V NMOS (strong low-side conduction),
* so the selected path reaches both 0 V and AVDD while unselected
* branches present only a negligible leakage load at VO.

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Static CMOS inverter
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt mux_inv A Y VDD VSS
XN Y A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends mux_inv

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Static CMOS 3-input NAND
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt mux_nand3 A B C Y VDD VSS
XN1 Y A na VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XN2 na B nb VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XN3 nb C VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP1 Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XP2 Y B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XP3 Y C VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends mux_nand3

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* One multiplexer branch: input -> TG -> mid -> TG -> output.
* SEL is high for the selected branch; SELB is its complement.
*
* The mid node is deliberately left floating at DC.  All eight inputs
* share the same common mode, so an unselected branch's mid settles at
* that common mode as well: the off devices then see almost no drain
* voltage and their leakage into VO is only the tiny Vds=0 subthreshold
* conductance.  At AC the mid sees the off-device and gate capacitance
* to the (small-signal grounded) gate/bulk nodes, which still isolates
* the unselected input from VO.
*
* The 5 V-gate PMOS devices are used for the high-side pass devices
* because their gate-induced drain leakage at Vgs=0 is orders of
* magnitude below that of the 1.8 V PMOS, which would otherwise load
* VO at VCM=AVDD.  The output-side PMOS is a two-device stack for
* additional margin.  The 1.8 V NMOS devices supply the low-side
* conduction with much lower capacitance (and the NMOS off current is
* small); their gate capacitance also helps AC-ground the mid node.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt mux_branch VIN VO MID SEL SELB VDD VSS
XNS1 VIN SEL MID VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XPS1 VIN SELB MID VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=200 nf=4
XNS2 MID SEL VO VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XPS2A VO SELB PM VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=200 nf=4
XPS2B PM SELB MID VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 l=0.5 w=200 nf=4
.ends mux_branch

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Top level
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt input_mux_8to1 AVDD AVSS S\<2\> S\<1\> S\<0\> VIN\<7\> VIN\<6\> VIN\<5\> VIN\<4\> VIN\<3\> VIN\<2\> VIN\<1\> VIN\<0\> VO

* Complementary select bits
XIS2 S\<2\> S2B AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XIS1 S\<1\> S1B AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XIS0 S\<0\> S0B AVDD AVSS mux_inv

* SEL<n> = (S2==b2) & (S1==b1) & (S0==b0)
* NAND output N<n> is the active-low branch select.
XNAND7 S\<2\> S\<1\> S\<0\> N7 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XD7 N7 SEL7 AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XNAND6 S\<2\> S\<1\> S0B N6 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XD6 N6 SEL6 AVDD AVSS mux_inv

XD5 N5 SEL5 AVDD AVSS mux_inv

XD4 N4 SEL4 AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XNAND3 S2B S\<1\> S\<0\> N3 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XD3 N3 SEL3 AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XNAND2 S2B S\<1\> S0B N2 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XD2 N2 SEL2 AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XNAND1 S2B S1B S\<0\> N1 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XD1 N1 SEL1 AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XNAND0 S2B S1B S0B N0 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XD0 N0 SEL0 AVDD AVSS mux_inv

* Eight analog branches, binary select 0..7.
XBR7 VIN\<7\> VO M7 SEL7 N7 AVDD AVSS mux_branch
XBR6 VIN\<6\> VO M6 SEL6 N6 AVDD AVSS mux_branch
XBR5 VIN\<5\> VO M5 SEL5 N5 AVDD AVSS mux_branch
XBR4 VIN\<4\> VO M4 SEL4 N4 AVDD AVSS mux_branch

* 8-to-1 analog input multiplexer.
* CMOS transmission-gate array driven by a static 3-to-8 one-hot decoder.
* Only official Sky130 PDK subcircuits are instantiated.

* Sizing notes:
*  - Pass devices use a long PMOS channel: at VCM = AVDD the unselected
*    PMOS sits at Vgs = 0, and a minimum-length pfet is then only ~0.5 V
*    below threshold, leaving a subthreshold channel conductance that
*    would shunt VO and spoil both gain flatness and off isolation.
*  - Logic devices also use l = 0.5 so that the short-channel pfet
*    subthreshold leakage stays far below the AVDD current budget.
*  - Pass widths are set by the selected-path pole, which must sit inside
*    the 1 mHz..1 GHz analysis window (so the falling 3 dB crossing is
*    found) while staying well above the 5 MHz bandwidth floor.  The pole
*    is ~1/(2*pi*(50 + Ron)*CL) and Ron is worst at mid-rail, where both
*    pass devices are only weakly on; at VCM = 0 / AVDD it is the NMOS /
*    PMOS alone.  Wn = 2 um (l = 0.15) and Wp = 32 um (l = 0.5) put the
*    pole in 12..485 MHz over the five PVT rows and three common modes.

circuit:
* 8-to-1 analog input multiplexer, transistor-level implementation.
*
* Topology: three cascaded 2:1 transmission-gate stages (binary tree).
*   Stage 1 (select S0): VIN0/VIN1 -> a0, VIN2/VIN3 -> a1,
*                        VIN4/VIN5 -> a2, VIN6/VIN7 -> a3
*   Stage 2 (select S1): a0/a1 -> b0, a2/a3 -> b1
*   Stage 3 (select S2): b0/b1 -> VO
* The LSB S0 chooses within each input pair, S1 between pairs, S2 between
* groups, so S<2:0> is the unsigned index of the selected VIN.
* Complements s0b/s1b/s2b are generated with minimum-size CMOS inverters
* (zero static current for rail-to-rail select levels).
*
* Switch devices: core nfet + high-Vt pfet transmission gate.
* At rail common modes one device of a TG is only weakly off (Vgs/Vsg = 0):
*   - nfet with Vgs = 0 (input at the bottom rail) leaks ~0.2 nS/2um, benign.
*   - a core pfet with Vsg = 0 (input at the top rail) would leak ~200 nS,
*     destroying gain accuracy and isolation, so the pull-up device is the
*     high-Vt pfet whose Vsg = 0 subthreshold leakage is ~1-3 nS instead.
* Away from the rails both devices are strongly off (|Vgs|, |Vsg| ~ VDD/2).
* Device bulk ties follow the standard-cell convention: nfet bulk to AVSS,
* pfet bulk (n-well) to AVDD.
*
* Transmission-gate switch cell: terminal order in out gn gp vdd vss.
* The n-device gate is the true select, the p-device gate the complement.
.subckt mux_tg in out gn gp vdd vss
XN in gn out vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1
XP in gp out vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_hvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends mux_tg

* Minimum-size inverter for select complements.
.subckt mux_inv vdd in out vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends mux_inv

.subckt input_mux_8to1 AVDD AVSS S\<2\> S\<1\> S\<0\> VIN\<7\> VIN\<6\> VIN\<5\> VIN\<4\> VIN\<3\> VIN\<2\> VIN\<1\> VIN\<0\> VO

* Select complements.
XIV2 AVDD S\<2\> s2b AVSS mux_inv
XIV1 AVDD S\<1\> s1b AVSS mux_inv
XIV0 AVDD S\<0\> s0b AVSS mux_inv

* Stage 1: S0 selects the low input of each pair when S0 = 0.

XT11 VIN\<1\> a0 S\<0\> s0b AVDD AVSS mux_tg
XT12 VIN\<2\> a1 s0b S\<0\> AVDD AVSS mux_tg
XT13 VIN\<3\> a1 S\<0\> s0b AVDD AVSS mux_tg

* current from AVDD (gates switch solely between AVSS and AVDD).

* ---- local hierarchy: inverter, 3-input NAND, transmission gate ----

XNI Z A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=2

.ends mux_inv

* three nfets in series pull-down, three pfets in parallel pull-up
XN1 N1 A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XN2 N2 B N1  VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2

.ends mux_nand3

* CMOS transmission gate: nfet gate=EN, HVT pfet gate=ENB.  The HVT pfet
* keeps Vgs=0 subthreshold leakage (the off state near VDD at the fast/hot
* corner) tiny, so unselected-channel crosstalk stays far below -80 dB, while
* both devices conduct strongly when selected.  Device widths are chosen so
* the on-resistance keeps the 3 dB bandwidth well above 5 MHz at every
* declared corner while the fast-corner bandwidth stays within the bench's
* AC sweep range; no DC bias current is drawn.

circuit:
* 8-to-1 analog input multiplexer.
*
* Architecture: a passive transmission gate per input, gated by a static
* 3-to-8 decode.  Because the selected path is a pure transistor channel and
* the 1 pF output load draws no DC current, no voltage is dropped across the
* source resistance or the switch, so the low-frequency gain is exactly 0 dB
* and AVDD carries only leakage current.
*
* Pass-device bulks are tied to their own source-side input node.  Each
* switch therefore has zero source-bulk and drain-bulk bias at every input
* common mode (0 V, VDD/2, VDD): no junction conduction and no body effect,
* which is what lets a single transmission gate span the full rail range.

* Helper subcircuits take supplies first, then signals.

.subckt mux_inv AVDD AVSS a y
XMNL y a AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
XMPL y a AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends mux_inv

.subckt mux_nand3 AVDD AVSS a b c y

XMP2 y b AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
XMP3 y c AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends mux_nand3

* ingate high / invgate low closes the gate.  The pull device is a high-Vt

circuit:
* 8-to-1 analog input multiplexer.
*
* Architecture: three-level binary tree of T-switches.  Level 1 steers
* the eight inputs into four nodes with S<0>, level 2 steers those into
* two nodes with S<1>, and level 3 steers those into VO with S<2>.
*
* Each branch is a T-switch: two complementary transmission gates in
* series (IN-MX, MX-OUT) plus a shunt transmission gate from MX to a
* quiet mid-rail node VMID that is enabled only while the signal path
* is disabled.  The series gates give rail-to-rail ON conduction (near
* AVSS the NFETs carry the signal, near AVDD the PFETs do), and the
* shunt holds every idle MX node at mid-rail so that in the OFF state
* each blocking device is either reverse biased or subthreshold with
* |VDS| near VDD/2, where its channel conductance is essentially zero.
* An unselected input therefore has to cross two such saturated
* barriers in series, which keeps channel feedthrough far below the
* required isolation at every common mode, and the mid-rail clamp also
* gives every internal node a defined DC operating point.
*
* The select bits are decoded with two CMOS inverters per bit, giving
* rail-to-rail true and complement drives.  Those inverters use
* long-channel minimum-width devices: they only charge the switch gates
* once, and the long channels keep their subthreshold AVDD-AVSS
* leakage in the nanoamp range at 125 C.
*
* VMID is generated on-chip with a matched poly resistor divider
* (two 2 kOhm/sq xhigh-poly resistors, 1 MOhm per side).  At the hot
* fast corner the switch PFETs at Vgs = 0 are weakly conductive, so the
* divider also has to absorb close to a microamp of barrier leakage
* while holding the clamp far enough from either rail that every
* blocking device stays in its saturated (exponentially suppressed)
* region; 1 MOhm per side satisfies both with well under a microamp of
* standing current.

* Complementary transmission gate between A and B.
* GN drives the NFET gate (high = enabled), GP drives the PFET gate
* (low = enabled).  Widths are the minimum that keep the six-gate
* selected path below a kilo-ohm at the slow corner, which also keeps
* the total Vgs = 0 PFET barrier leakage at the hot fast corner in the
* hundreds of nanoamps.
.subckt mux_tg A B GN GP AVDD AVSS
XMN B GN A AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XMP B GP A AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
.ends mux_tg

* T-switch between IN and OUT.  Path gates GN/GP enable the two series
* gates; the shunt gate pair is the same two nets swapped, so the shunt
* conducts exactly when the path is disabled and clamps MX to VMID.
.subckt mux_tsw IN OUT GN GP VMID AVDD AVSS
XA IN MX GN GP AVDD AVSS mux_tg
XB MX OUT GN GP AVDD AVSS mux_tg
XS MX VMID GP GN AVDD AVSS mux_tg
.ends mux_tsw

* CMOS inverter: Y = ~A, rail-to-rail output.  Square-law minimum
* geometry (W/L = 1) keeps subthreshold AVDD-AVSS leakage at a few
* nanoamps per gate at 125 C while still driving the switch-gate
* capacitance with a tens-of-kilohm output resistance.
.subckt mux_inv A Y AVDD AVSS
XMN Y A AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.42 w=0.42 nf=1
XMP Y A AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.42 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends mux_inv

circuit:
* 8-to-1 analog input multiplexer selected by the three-bit code S<2:0>.
*
* A static CMOS 3-to-8 decoder produces one active-high line per channel.  The
* selected line turns on that channel's transmission gate; every other line
* holds its transmission gate off.  Pure static CMOS draws no DC current from
* AVDD, and each gate line is driven from a low-impedance rail, so the seven
* deselected gates act as stiff AC grounds that suppress feedthrough into VO.
*
* The signal path is a single transmission gate between VIN<i> and VO.  VO
* carries only the 1 pF external load, so at DC no current flows through the
* selected gate and the 1 mHz transfer is unity; the -3 dB corner is set by
* the 50 ohm source resistance plus the gate on-resistance driving that load.
*
* Public interface wrapper.  ngspice treats the bracketed pin names of this
* subcircuit as node names distinct from their unbracketed spellings, so the
* body lives in amx_core, which uses ordinary node names, and this wrapper
* only forwards terminals positionally.

* 8-to-1 analog input multiplexer (transistor-level, Sky130)
* Passive transmission-gate switches with a static CMOS 3-to-8 decoder.
* Pin order: AVDD AVSS S2 S1 S0 VIN7..VIN0 VO
* Selected input index = unsigned binary value of S2 S1 S0.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Local primitives
*----------------------------------------------------------------------

* CMOS inverter. in -> out.
.subckt mux_inv in out vdd vss
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
.ends mux_inv

* 3-input NAND. out = ~(a & b & c).
.subckt mux_nand3 a b c out vdd vss
XMP1 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=3
XMP2 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=3
XMP3 out c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=3
XMN1 out a  n1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=3
XMN2 n1  b  n2  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=3
XMN3 n2  c  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=3
.ends mux_nand3

* T-switch (low-leakage transmission gate). ON when ng=1 (VDD) and pg=0.
* in -- TGa -- mid -- TGb -- out.  When OFF, mid is clamped to vss by an
* NMOS (gate=pg). Holding mid at a rail forces the OFF pass devices from
* Vsd=0 (slope conductance, leaky) into subthreshold saturation (DIBL
* limited), collapsing feedthrough and off-leakage by a large factor.
.subckt mux_tg in out ng pg vdd vss
XMA mid ng in  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0  nf=2
XPA mid pg in  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0  nf=2
XMB out ng mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0  nf=2
XPB out pg mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0  nf=2
XCL mid pg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0  nf=2
.ends mux_tg

*----------------------------------------------------------------------

XI0 N0  Y0  AVDD AVSS mux_inv

XI1 N1  Y1  AVDD AVSS mux_inv

* k2 = 010

XI2 N2  Y2  AVDD AVSS mux_inv

* k3 = 011

XI3 N3  Y3  AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XT3 VIN\<3\> VO Y3  N3  AVDD AVSS mux_tg
* k4 = 100
XN4 S\<2\>  S1B S0B N4  AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XI4 N4  Y4  AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XT4 VIN\<4\> VO Y4  N4  AVDD AVSS mux_tg
* k5 = 101
XN5 S\<2\>  S1B S\<0\>  N5  AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XI5 N5  Y5  AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XT5 VIN\<5\> VO Y5  N5  AVDD AVSS mux_tg
* k6 = 110
XN6 S\<2\>  S\<1\>  S0B N6  AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XI6 N6  Y6  AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XT6 VIN\<6\> VO Y6  N6  AVDD AVSS mux_tg

circuit:
* 8-to-1 analog input multiplexer (transistor level, Sky130 1.8V core devices)
* Selection: 3-bit code S<2:0> (unsigned binary index 0..7).
* Each channel is a T-switch: two series transmission gates (TG1,TG2) with a
* shunt clamp (TG3) on the midpoint that turns ON only when the channel is
* unselected.  This gives two-pole feedthrough isolation so OFF-channel
* crosstalk stays below -80 dB up to 1 MHz.  A static CMOS 3-to-8 decoder
* (AND3 gates) produces the per-channel enable EN<k> and its complement ENB<k>.
.subckt input_mux_8to1 AVDD AVSS S\<2\> S\<1\> S\<0\> VIN\<7\> VIN\<6\> VIN\<5\> VIN\<4\> VIN\<3\> VIN\<2\> VIN\<1\> VIN\<0\> VO

* ---- select complements ----
XI2 S\<2\> NS2 AVDD AVSS inv
XI1 S\<1\> NS1 AVDD AVSS inv
XI0 S\<0\> NS0 AVDD AVSS inv

* ---- 3-to-8 decoder: EN<k> high only for the selected code ----
XA0 NS2 NS1 NS0 E0 AVDD AVSS and3
XA1 NS2 NS1 S\<0\> E1 AVDD AVSS and3
XA2 NS2 S\<1\> NS0 E2 AVDD AVSS and3
XA3 NS2 S\<1\> S\<0\> E3 AVDD AVSS and3
XA4 S\<2\> NS1 NS0 E4 AVDD AVSS and3
XA5 S\<2\> NS1 S\<0\> E5 AVDD AVSS and3
XA6 S\<2\> S\<1\> NS0 E6 AVDD AVSS and3
XA7 S\<2\> S\<1\> S\<0\> E7 AVDD AVSS and3

* ---- enable complements for the PMOS gates ----
XB0 E0 EB0 AVDD AVSS inv
XB1 E1 EB1 AVDD AVSS inv
XB2 E2 EB2 AVDD AVSS inv
XB3 E3 EB3 AVDD AVSS inv
XB4 E4 EB4 AVDD AVSS inv
XB5 E5 EB5 AVDD AVSS inv
XB6 E6 EB6 AVDD AVSS inv
XB7 E7 EB7 AVDD AVSS inv

* ---- channels (T-switches) ----
XC0 VIN\<0\> VO E0 EB0 AVDD AVSS muxch
XC1 VIN\<1\> VO E1 EB1 AVDD AVSS muxch
XC2 VIN\<2\> VO E2 EB2 AVDD AVSS muxch
XC3 VIN\<3\> VO E3 EB3 AVDD AVSS muxch
XC4 VIN\<4\> VO E4 EB4 AVDD AVSS muxch
XC5 VIN\<5\> VO E5 EB5 AVDD AVSS muxch
XC6 VIN\<6\> VO E6 EB6 AVDD AVSS muxch
XC7 VIN\<7\> VO E7 EB7 AVDD AVSS muxch
.ends input_mux_8to1

* ---- static CMOS inverter ----
.subckt inv in out AVDD AVSS
XMP out in AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XMN out in AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends inv

.subckt nand3 a b c out AVDD AVSS

XMP2 out b AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1

.subckt and3 a b c out AVDD AVSS

.ends and3

XIS1 S\<1\> SB1 AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XIS0 S\<0\> SB0 AVDD AVSS mux_inv

* Decoder NAND outputs are active low; the following inverters make EN0..EN7.
XND0 SB2 SB1 SB0 ENB0 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XND1 SB2 SB1 S\<0\> ENB1 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XND2 SB2 S\<1\> SB0 ENB2 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XND3 SB2 S\<1\> S\<0\> ENB3 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XND4 S\<2\> SB1 SB0 ENB4 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XND5 S\<2\> SB1 S\<0\> ENB5 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XND6 S\<2\> S\<1\> SB0 ENB6 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XND7 S\<2\> S\<1\> S\<0\> ENB7 AVDD AVSS mux_nand3
XIE0 ENB0 EN0 AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XIE1 ENB1 EN1 AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XIE2 ENB2 EN2 AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XIE3 ENB3 EN3 AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XIE4 ENB4 EN4 AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XIE5 ENB5 EN5 AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XIE6 ENB6 EN6 AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XIE7 ENB7 EN7 AVDD AVSS mux_inv

XP0 VIN\<0\> VO EN0 ENB0 AVDD AVSS mux_path
XP1 VIN\<1\> VO EN1 ENB1 AVDD AVSS mux_path
XP2 VIN\<2\> VO EN2 ENB2 AVDD AVSS mux_path
XP3 VIN\<3\> VO EN3 ENB3 AVDD AVSS mux_path
XP4 VIN\<4\> VO EN4 ENB4 AVDD AVSS mux_path
XP5 VIN\<5\> VO EN5 ENB5 AVDD AVSS mux_path
XP6 VIN\<6\> VO EN6 ENB6 AVDD AVSS mux_path
XP7 VIN\<7\> VO EN7 ENB7 AVDD AVSS mux_path
.ends input_mux_8to1

* 8:1 analog multiplexer.  A three-level transmission-gate tree keeps the
* signal path passive while static CMOS inverters provide complementary selects.
.subckt mux_inv A Y VP VN
XP Y A VP VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1.0 l=0.15 nf=1
XN Y A VN VN sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.50 l=0.15 nf=1
.ends mux_inv

.subckt mux_tg A B EN ENB VP VN
XN B EN  A VN sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5.00 l=0.50 nf=1
XP B ENB A VP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10.0 l=0.50 nf=1
.ends mux_tg

.subckt input_mux_8to1 AVDD AVSS S\<2\> S\<1\> S\<0\> VIN\<7\> VIN\<6\> VIN\<5\> VIN\<4\> VIN\<3\> VIN\<2\> VIN\<1\> VIN\<0\> VO
XIS2 S\<2\> S2B AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XIS1 S\<1\> S1B AVDD AVSS mux_inv
XIS0 S\<0\> S0B AVDD AVSS mux_inv

* First level: select the low-order bit within each adjacent input pair.
X00 VIN\<0\> N00 S0B S\<0\> AVDD AVSS mux_tg
X01 VIN\<1\> N00 S\<0\> S0B AVDD AVSS mux_tg
X02 VIN\<2\> N01 S0B S\<0\> AVDD AVSS mux_tg
X03 VIN\<3\> N01 S\<0\> S0B AVDD AVSS mux_tg
X04 VIN\<4\> N02 S0B S\<0\> AVDD AVSS mux_tg
X05 VIN\<5\> N02 S\<0\> S0B AVDD AVSS mux_tg
X06 VIN\<6\> N03 S0B S\<0\> AVDD AVSS mux_tg
X07 VIN\<7\> N03 S\<0\> S0B AVDD AVSS mux_tg

* Second and third levels select the remaining address bits.
X10 N00 N10 S1B S\<1\> AVDD AVSS mux_tg
X11 N01 N10 S\<1\> S1B AVDD AVSS mux_tg
X12 N02 N11 S1B S\<1\> AVDD AVSS mux_tg
X13 N03 N11 S\<1\> S1B AVDD AVSS mux_tg
X20 N10 VO S2B S\<2\> AVDD AVSS mux_tg
X21 N11 VO S\<2\> S2B AVDD AVSS mux_tg
.ends input_mux_8to1

* Static CMOS 3-input decode cell.  ENB is the NAND output and EN is its
* complement; both are used to drive one transmission gate.
.subckt mux_decode3 AVDD AVSS A B C EN ENB
XDP0 ENB A AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XDP1 ENB B AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XDP2 ENB C AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XDN0 ENB A DN0 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDN1 DN0 B DN1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDN2 DN1 C AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XIP0 EN ENB AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XIN0 EN ENB AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends mux_decode3

* The physical poly resistor establishes zero DC body bias at every specified
* common mode.  The physical MIM capacitor makes that bias node AC-quiet, so
* the body junction is not a feedthrough path at 1 MHz.
.subckt mux_tgate3 AVDD AVSS EN ENB IN OUT
XRB IN BODY AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=0.35 l=175
XCB BODY AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=22 l=22 mf=1
XTN0 OUT EN IN BODY sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=0.72 nf=1
XTP0 OUT ENB IN BODY sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=1.44 nf=1
.ends mux_tgate3

.subckt input_mux_8to1 AVDD AVSS S\<2\> S\<1\> S\<0\> VIN\<7\> VIN\<6\> VIN\<5\> VIN\<4\> VIN\<3\> VIN\<2\> VIN\<1\> VIN\<0\> VO
* Select complements.
XCP0 S0B S\<0\> AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XCN0 S0B S\<0\> AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XCP1 S1B S\<1\> AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XCN1 S1B S\<1\> AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XCP2 S2B S\<2\> AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XCN2 S2B S\<2\> AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

* The NAND literals are high for exactly one binary select code.
XD0 AVDD AVSS S2B S1B S0B E0 E0B mux_decode3
XD1 AVDD AVSS S2B S1B S\<0\> E1 E1B mux_decode3
XD2 AVDD AVSS S2B S\<1\> S0B E2 E2B mux_decode3
XD3 AVDD AVSS S2B S\<1\> S\<0\> E3 E3B mux_decode3
XD4 AVDD AVSS S\<2\> S1B S0B E4 E4B mux_decode3
XD5 AVDD AVSS S\<2\> S1B S\<0\> E5 E5B mux_decode3
XD6 AVDD AVSS S\<2\> S\<1\> S0B E6 E6B mux_decode3
XD7 AVDD AVSS S\<2\> S\<1\> S\<0\> E7 E7B mux_decode3

* One isolated rail-to-rail branch per analog input.
XT0 AVDD AVSS E0 E0B VIN\<0\> VO mux_tgate3
XT1 AVDD AVSS E1 E1B VIN\<1\> VO mux_tgate3
XT2 AVDD AVSS E2 E2B VIN\<2\> VO mux_tgate3
XT3 AVDD AVSS E3 E3B VIN\<3\> VO mux_tgate3
XT4 AVDD AVSS E4 E4B VIN\<4\> VO mux_tgate3
XT5 AVDD AVSS E5 E5B VIN\<5\> VO mux_tgate3
XT6 AVDD AVSS E6 E6B VIN\<6\> VO mux_tgate3
XT7 AVDD AVSS E7 E7B VIN\<7\> VO mux_tgate3
.ends input_mux_8to1
